resources.string: Experimental feature: use favorites, watch-later and playlists without logging in, with two-way sync when logged in. Issues may occur — please report them at GitHub Issues.
Clear favorites / watch-later / playlists stored on this device (cloud data is kept)
Local data not yet synced to the cloud will be lost. Clear anyway?
Also clear local favorites / watch-later / playlist data
This feature requires login, or you can enable the experimental local feature in Settings.
